info.name: IN DENTAL CARE - REST API Testing Collection (All Modules)
info.description:
Koleksi lengkap Postman untuk pengujian otomatis (SQA & Integration Testing) seluruh modul backend IN DENTAL CARE:
1. Health Check
2. Modul Autentikasi (/api/v1/auth)
3. Modul Dashboard Overview (/api/v1/dashboard)
4. Modul Kelola Dokter (/api/v1/dokter)
5. Modul Kelola Reservasi (/api/v1/reservasi)
6. Modul Rekam Medis EMR (/api/v1/rekam-medis)
7. Endpoint 404 Not Found Handling

Dilengkapi pm.test assertion untuk kode status, response time, format JSON, error code, serta auto-chaining JWT token dan dynamic IDs.
